status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_task (task_id,task_type,biz_key,biz_version,payload,payload_hash,status,attempts,max_attempts,next_run_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{task.taskId},#{task.taskType},#{task.bizKey},#{task.bizVersion},#{task.payload},#{task.payloadHash},'READY',0,#{task.maxAttempts}, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delaySeconds},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_id = task_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM business_task WHERE task_type=#{type} AND biz_key=#{key} AND biz_version=#{version} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM business_task WHERE task_type IN #{type} AND ORDER BY next_run_at,created_at,task_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE business_task SET status='RUNNING',attempts=attempts+1,lease_owner=#{owner}, lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{leaseSeconds},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{id} AND attempts < max_attempts AND
UPDATE business_task SET status='DEAD',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error='LEASE_EXHAUSTED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{id} AND attempts >= max_attempts AND
UPDATE business_task SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{leaseSeconds},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{id} AND
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM business_task WHERE task_id=#{id} AND
mapper.update: UPDATE business_task SET status='SUCCESS',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{id} AND

UPDATE business_task SET status=IF(attempts >= max_attempts,'DEAD','RETRY'),lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL, next_run_at=TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,#{delayMillis} * 1000,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),last_error=#{errorCode},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{id} AND

UPDATE business_task SET status='RETRY',attempts=attempts-1,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL, next_run_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,60,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),last_error='BUSINESS_PENDING',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{id} AND attempts > 0 AND
UPDATE business_task SET status='READY',attempts=0,next_run_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE task_id=#{id} AND status='DEAD'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM business_task WHERE status='DEAD' ORDER BY updated_at,task_id LIMIT #{limit}
